commits.subject: Drop the E E ligature the release does not carry
commits.body:
Nosifer-Regular.ttf was exported with FontForge's OpenType tables off (legacy
kern, no GSUB), so this liga never shipped. The absence exists only in the
release; the E_E glyph itself stays.

future_work: Restore the E E ligature (liga -> E_E) the source defines. The shipped Nosifer-Regular.ttf lacks it only because FontForge exported it with its OpenType tables off; the commit that drops it can simply be reverted.
